camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainPushBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the network bandwidth monitoring data for stream ingest on an ingest domain by calling DescribeLiveDomainPushBpsData
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveDomainPushBpsData获取推流域名的推流网络带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-push-bps-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainPushBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The ingest domain.
Batch domain name queries are supported. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all ingest domains is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
推流域名。
支持批量域名查询，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若参数为空，默认返回所有推流域名合并后数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). If you do not specify this parameter, data from the last 24 hours is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

300
3600
86400

If you do not specify this parameter or the specified value is not supported, the default value 300 is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：

300。
3600。
86400。

不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain ISP names. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all ISPs is returned
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名.
可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，不传默认为所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region in English.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to obtain region names. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh:
区域英文名。
可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，不传默认为所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en
